name: binutils
description: The Binutils package contains a linker, an assembler, and other tools for handling object files.

installed_descriptions.name: addr2line
installed_descriptions.description: Translates program addresses to file names and line numbers; given an address and the name of an executable, it uses the debugging information in the executable to determine which source file and line number are associated with the address

installed_descriptions.name: ar
installed_descriptions.description: Creates, modifies, and extracts from archives

installed_descriptions.name: as
installed_descriptions.description: An assembler that assembles the output of gcc into object files

installed_descriptions.name: c++filt
installed_descriptions.description: Used by the linker to de-mangle C++ and Java symbols and to keep overloaded functions from clashing

installed_descriptions.name: dwp
installed_descriptions.description: The DWARF packaging utility

installed_descriptions.name: elfedit
installed_descriptions.description: Updates the ELF headers of ELF files

installed_descriptions.name: gprof
installed_descriptions.description: Displays call graph profile data

installed_descriptions.name: gprofng
installed_descriptions.description: Gathers and analyzes performance data

installed_descriptions.name: ld
installed_descriptions.description: A linker that combines a number of object and archive files into a single file, relocating their data and tying up symbol references

installed_descriptions.name: ld.bfd
installed_descriptions.description: A hard link to ld

installed_descriptions.name: nm
installed_descriptions.description: Lists the symbols occurring in a given object file

installed_descriptions.name: objcopy
installed_descriptions.description: Translates one type of object file into another

installed_descriptions.name: objdump
installed_descriptions.description: Displays information about the given object file, with options controlling the particular information to display; the information shown is useful to programmers who are working on the compilation tools

installed_descriptions.name: ranlib
installed_descriptions.description: Generates an index of the contents of an archive and stores it in the archive; the index lists all of the symbols defined by archive members that are relocatable object files

installed_descriptions.name: readelf
installed_descriptions.description: Displays information about ELF type binaries

installed_descriptions.name: size
installed_descriptions.description: Lists the section sizes and the total size for the given object files

installed_descriptions.name: strings
installed_descriptions.description: Outputs, for each given file, the sequences of printable characters that are of at least the specified length (defaulting to four); for object files, it prints, by default, only the strings from the initializing and loading sections while for other types of files, it scans the entire file

installed_descriptions.name: strip
installed_descriptions.description: Discards symbols from object files

installed_descriptions.name: libbfd
installed_descriptions.description: The Binary File Descriptor library

installed_descriptions.name: libctf
installed_descriptions.description: The Compat ANSI-C Type Format debugging support library

installed_descriptions.name: libctf-nobfd
installed_descriptions.description: A libctf variant which does not use libbfd functionality

installed_descriptions.name: libgprofng
installed_descriptions.description: A library containing most routines used by gprofng

installed_descriptions.name: libopcodes
installed_descriptions.description: A library for dealing with opcodes—the readable text versions of instructions for the processor; it is used for building utilities like objdump

installed_descriptions.name: libsframe
installed_descriptions.description: A library to support online backtracing using a simple unwinder
